Ruling: Use deterministic evidence/topic/path selection with all relevant counterexamples, applicable instructions/native gates and disclosed unavailable bodies, rather than a model relevance filter or silent file cap — task evidence must remain independently verifiable — unselected sources remain unknown and broad explicitly requested seeds may still produce a large task context.

Ruling: Use a fresh authorized pinned-copy E2E round at the same 12/1200000 cap and preserve all prior runs and this round's attempts — the user requested rerunning the new policy — this adds a separately recorded real test round and cannot erase earlier consumption.

Ruling: Re-read selected files through the filtered reader when preparing/importing stage context instead of trusting a mutable full-project snapshot — strict comparison verifies even self-digested extra or changed cache bodies against current visible source — selected reads remain charged and can exhaust a tight read budget sooner.

Ruling: Reuse unchanged analysis/planning but regenerate content and independent acceptance when their evidence contract changes — the two findings affect artifact-stage authority, and the saved plan retains the complete source research — a future change to planning semantics would need a separate plan invalidation contract. The same original run and ledger will retain all 4 calls / 341053 tokens and charge the follow-up; no new budget round.
